panels.description: Archive recording: Adrian stands in rising water before a transmission console. Leave upper space for his line.
Adrian faces the archive camera, with water rising behind him. Keep his face and console clear; reserve upper area.
The bulkhead closes as Adrian's hand disappears behind it. Leave upper area for the impact sound.
B11 watches the recording in the dark archive. His brass eye ring remains a quiet mechanical detail; leave upper space.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: Alex. The rest is yours to choose.

items.speaker: B11
items.text: I kept waiting for a better instruction.
